instruction: Transpose Bend - Curl a Tapered Tail into a 180 deg C-Shape The opened `scene.obj` contains a ZBrush Tool whose first (and only) SubTool, named Tail, is a straight tapered cylinder running along +X from (0, 0, 0) to (1.5, 0, 0). Radius tapers from 0.10 BU at the root (x=0) to 0.03 BU at the tip (x=1.5). 40 length segments x 12 circular segments, with cap fans at both ends - ~494 vertices and ~504 faces. Single polygroup. Using the opened OBJ in ZBrush, use Transpose Bend to curl the tail into a half-circle (180 deg arc) while keeping the root anchored. Export the result as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\output.obj`. The exported `C:\Users\user\Desktop\output.obj` must satisfy: - Exactly one SubTool, named Tail. - Face count and vertex count preserved exactly (Bend never adds or removes topology). - Every vertex with original x approx 0 (root ring) has displacement < 0.001 BU - the root is anchored. - Endpoint chord divided by original arc length (= 1.5) equals 2/pi approx 0.6366 within 5% - confirming a 180 deg C-shape. - Centerline discrete curvature stdev < 0.1 (curvature is approximately constant along the bend).

command: import pyautogui, time; time.sleep(20); pyautogui.press('enter'); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.press('enter'); time.sleep(5)
